scope: All original JSONL measurements with this exact world_id; matching persisted database rows; chronicle text only for sessions containing exclusively this world.
exclusions: Code, ZIP backups and Steam files
identity_note: Database histories without world_id are selected by their persisted world name and labelled identity_basis=world. No retrospective identity is invented.
consistency: Read-only SQLite backup in memory; session files read to inventoried byte lengths. Not an atomic snapshot across all storage locations.
duplicates: Recorded session observations are retained without deduplication; database histories are independent representations.
